name: program-runtime.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every row of program-runtime's improve setpoint in one submission and report each as in band, out of band, or declined with a reason from the closed vocabulary, without estimating.

governance_window_seconds.description: Window for the governed-share and binding-condition readings.

agent_failure_band.description: Upper band for the agent program failure rate.

assumptions: program-runtime is running and its own bindings are reachable from the kernel
the caller treats a declined row as unknown, never as zero, and acts on its reason (program-contracts.md, the reason table)

agent-failure-rate is computed over PROVENANCE_AGENT programs created in the last 30 days: programs/list applies provenance=agent and since_seconds=2592000 before the bounded handle reaches the kernel

discovery eval has no program binding (no_governed_binding); authoring eval has one but its run exceeds the 100 s kernel invoke budget (kernel_invoke_budget): both rows are read from the shell, never in-program
program-adoption uses the portfolio's last-30-days agent-run denominator and caller identity; rows with caller_harness=daemon are excluded because the improve loop is an operator, not adoption

portfolio-maturity delegates to program-runtime.portfolio-audit at min_rung=S3; program-health counts declared portfolio rows with a failed execution; unexercised-contracts uses the portfolio never_executed set
external-friction and fleet-improve-coverage are read by agent-manager.friction-digest and prompt-manager.skill-set-read; attribution waits on agent-manager telemetry (pending_telemetry)
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized; every reading is count, head, group_by, or meta
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
every read is guarded on its own worker: one dead binding yields one row with reason scenario_unreachable and the other rows survive
a row with a permanent reason never lowers the status; only a failed read makes the board partial
a declined row carries reading null; a number is never printed for a row that was not evaluated

bindings.note: rows="conditions"; the status group_by uses CONDITION_STATUS_* from bindings.proto
Windowed declared-program execution, health, adoption denominator, and never_executed metadata.
Nested declared maturity score; unavailable child output remains unavailable here.

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason} in the improve skill's table order: discovery-floor, authoring-floor, agent-failure-rate, program-adoption, portfolio-maturity, program-health, unexercised-contracts, governance-share, act-coverage, binding-condition, delegation-live, uncovered-recurring-shapes, attribution, external-friction, fleet-improve-coverage; reason is one of no_governed_binding, kernel_invoke_budget, scenario_unreachable, read_elsewhere:<program>, pending_telemetry, unreliable:<why>
signals.readable: count of rows read from a governed binding
signals.unavailable: count of rows declined, permanent reasons included
signals.failure_shapes: top recurring failure shapes from programs mine, at most six

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row

fixtures.note: ok under the permanent-rows rule: five rows are declined by construction (no_governed_binding, kernel_invoke_budget, pending_telemetry, two read_elsewhere) and none of them lowers the status. partial means a governed read failed this time.
